174392.name: prx-5
174392.summary: Enables peroxisome targeting sequence binding activity. Involved in nematode larval development and protein import into peroxisome matrix. Predicted to be active in cytosol and peroxisomal membrane. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestine; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2A; peroxisome biogenesis disorder 2B; and rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 5. Orthologous to several human genes including PEX5 (peroxisomal biogenesis factor 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174422.name: mrpl-50
174422.summary: Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL50 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L50). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174427.name: sftd-3
174427.summary: Predicted to be involved in vesicle-mediated transport. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm; endomembrane system; and membrane. Orthologous to human SFT2D3 (SFT2 domain containing 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174428.name: ndub-3
174428.summary: Predicted to be involved in electron transport chain. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex I. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nuclear type mitochondrial complex I deficiency 25. Orthologous to human NDUFB3 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase subunit B3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174436.name: tdp-1
174436.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity and single-stranded RNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including RNA splicing; determination of adult lifespan; and hyperosmotic response. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; intestine; muscle cell; neurons; and pharynx. Used to study amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 10. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Parkinson's disease; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 10; and motor neuron disease. Orthologous to human TARDBP (TAR DNA binding protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174462.name: let-23
174462.description: Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase let-23;receptor protein-tyrosine kinase
174462.otherdesignations: Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase let-23;receptor protein-tyrosine kinase
174462.nomenclaturename: Receptor tyrosine-protein kinase let-23;receptor protein-tyrosine kinase
174462.summary: Enables epidermal growth factor receptor activity; lipid binding activity; and molecular function activator activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of vulval development; reproductive structure development; and vulval cell fate specification. Located in several cellular components, including apical plasma membrane; basolateral plasma membrane; and lateral plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including apoptotic cell; epithelial cell; head; somatic nervous system; and vulval precursor cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 19; carcinoma (multiple); gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); lung disease (multiple); and reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ERBB4 (erb-b2 receptor tyrosine kinase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174472.name: acs-7
174472.summary: Enables medium-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Involved in ascaroside biosynthetic process. Located in peroxisome. Is expressed in intestinal cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174476.name: eat-3
174476.summary: Predicted to enable GTPase activity and microtubule binding activity. Involved in several processes, including mitochondrial fusion; nematode larval development; and response to superoxide. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in intestinal cell; muscle cell; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Behr syndrome; dominant optic atrophy plus syndrome; mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 14; optic atrophy; and optic atrophy 1. Orthologous to human OPA1 (OPA1 mitochondrial dynamin like GTPase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174478.name: eif-3.F
174478.description: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit F
174478.otherdesignations: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit F
174478.nomenclaturename: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit F
174478.summary: Predicted to enable metal-dependent deubiquitinase activity and translation initiation factor binding activity. Predicted to contribute to translation initiation factor activity. Involved in translation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 complex, eIF3m. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder 67. Orthologous to human EIF3F (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit F). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174544.name: unc-4
174544.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of canonical Wnt signaling pathway; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and nervous system development. Located in axon and nucleus. Is expressed in AVF; I5 neuron; cholinergic neurons; and somatic nervous system. Orthologous to human ESX1 (ESX homeobox 1); RHOXF1 (Rhox homeobox family member 1); and RHOXF2B (Rhox homeobox family member 2B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174554.name: R53.4
174554.description: Putative ATP synthase subunit f, mitochondrial
174554.otherdesignations: Putative ATP synthase subunit f, mitochondrial
174554.nomenclaturename: Putative ATP synthase subunit f, mitochondrial
174554.summary: Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton motive force-driven mitochondrial ATP synthesis. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial membrane. Predicted to be part of proton-transporting ATP synthase complex. Orthologous to human ATP5MF (ATP synthase membrane subunit f). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174577.name: daf-19
174577.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Acts upstream of or within serotonin biosynthetic process. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; hypodermis; intestine; neurons; and somatic nervous system. Orthologous to several human genes including RFX1 (regulatory factor X1) and RFX2 (regulatory factor X2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174590.name: atad-3
174590.summary: Predicted to enable ATP binding activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. Involved in mitochondrion organization. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Harel-Yoon syndrome and neonatal lethal pontocerebellar hypoplasia, hypotonia, and respiratory insufficiency syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including ATAD3A (ATPase family AAA domain containing 3A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174623.name: mnk-1
174623.summary: Predicted to enable calcium-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity; calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase activity; and calmodulin binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and regulation of protein deneddylation. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in body wall musculature; intestine; pharyngeal muscle cell; pharynx; and vulval muscle. Orthologous to several human genes including MKNK2 (MAPK interacting serine/threonine kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174624.name: cdc-48.1
174624.summary: Enables ATP hydrolysis activity and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including ERAD pathway; positive regulation of mitotic cell cycle, embryonic; and positive regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in nucleoplasm and perinuclear region of cytoplasm. Part of VCP-NPL4-UFD1 AAA ATPase complex. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; germ line; and gonad. Used to study amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2Y; Paget's disease of bone; frontotemporal dementia and/or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 6; inclusion body myopathy with early-onset Paget disease of bone with or without frontotemporal dementia 1; and inclusion body myositis. Orthologous to human VCP (valosin containing protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174634.name: crn-5
174634.summary: Enables double-stranded DNA binding activity and enzyme binding activity. Involved in RNA processing and apoptotic DNA fragmentation. Part of exosome (RNase complex). Orthologous to human EXOSC5 (exosome component 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174657.name: mpz-1
174657.summary: Enables GTPase activating protein binding activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of insulin receptor signaling pathway. Located in axon. Is expressed in body wall musculature; nerve ring; neurons; and vulval muscle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hydrocephalus. Orthologous to human PATJ (PATJ crumbs cell polarity complex component) and MPDZ (multiple PDZ domain crumbs cell polarity complex component). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174680.name: tba-4
174680.summary: Predicted to enable GTP binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Predicted to be involved in microtubule cytoskeleton organization and mitotic cell cycle. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and microtubule. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in lissencephaly; lissencephaly 3; and microcephaly. Orthologous to several human genes including TUBA1A (tubulin alpha 1a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174683.name: tceb-3
174683.summary: Involved in transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Part of transcription elongation factor complex. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; intestine; nervous system; non-striated muscle; and pharynx. Orthologous to human ELOA (elongin A) and ELOA2 (elongin A2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174696.name: nuo-1
174696.summary: Predicted to enable 4 iron, 4 sulfur cluster binding activity; NADH dehydrogenase (ubiquinone) activity; and nucleotide binding activity. Involved in several processes, including dauer exit; determination of adult lifespan; and inductive cell migration. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study mitochondrial complex I deficiency and mitochondrial metabolism disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nuclear type mitochondrial complex I deficiency 4. Orthologous to human NDUFV1 (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase core subunit V1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174713.name: cchl-1
174713.summary: Predicted to enable holocytochrome-c synthase activity. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in linear skin defects with multiple congenital anomalies 1 and microphthalmia. Orthologous to human HCCS (holocytochrome c synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174726.name: raga-1
174726.summary: Predicted to enable GTP binding activity and GTPase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of TOR signaling; and regulation of growth. Predicted to be part of Gtr1-Gtr2 GTPase complex. Predicted to be active in lysosome and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including anterior hypodermis; gonad; and intestine. Used to study ragopathy. Orthologous to several human genes including RRAGA (Ras related GTP binding A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174743.name: vha-6
174743.description: V-type proton ATPase 116 kDa subunit a 3
174743.otherdesignations: V-type proton ATPase 116 kDa subunit a 3
174743.nomenclaturename: V-type proton ATPase 116 kDa subunit a 3
174743.summary: Predicted to enable ATPase binding activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in vacuolar acidification. Located in apical plasma membrane. Part of vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex. Is expressed in several structures, including Psub2; excretory cell; intestine; pharyngeal-intestinal valve; and uterus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive cutis laxa type IIA; autosomal recessive distal renal tubular acidosis 3 with or without sensorineural hearing loss; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 104; renal tubular acidosis; and wrinkly skin syndrome. Orthologous to human ATP6V0A1 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a1); ATP6V0A2 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a2); and ATP6V0A4 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit a4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174752.name: slc-25A37
174752.summary: Predicted to enable ferrous iron transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to be involved in iron import into the mitochondrion. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial membrane. Is expressed in intestine and nervous system. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC25A28 (solute carrier family 25 member 28). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174762.name: age-1
174762.summary: Predicted to enable 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity and 1-phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate 3-kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including dauer entry; determination of adult lifespan; and regulation of synaptic assembly at neuromuscular junction. Located in cytoplasm and non-motile cilium. Part of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex. Is expressed in anchor cell; hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and pharyngeal-intestinal valve. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including CLOVES syndrome; Cowden syndrome 5; breast cancer (multiple); gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); and reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including PIK3CA (phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174782.name: din-1
174782.summary: Predicted to enable ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Predicted to be involved in ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; hermaphrodite distal tip cell; intestine; pharynx; and vulval precursor cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in esophagus squamous cell carcinoma. Orthologous to human SPEN (spen family transcriptional repressor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174789.name: C47D12.2
174789.summary: Predicted to be involved in Golgi organization. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Dyggve-Melchior-Clausen disease; Smith-McCort dysplasia 1; and osteochondrodysplasia. Orthologous to human DYM (dymeclin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174790.name: tars-1
174790.summary: Predicted to enable threonine-tRNA ligase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in anal depressor muscle; body wall musculature; intestine; pharyngeal gland cell; and pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 21 and nonphotosensitive trichothiodystrophy 7. Orthologous to several human genes including TARS3 (threonyl-tRNA synthetase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174823.name: npp-3
174823.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of nuclear pore. Involved in several processes, including establishment of mitotic spindle orientation; nuclear pore complex assembly; and positive regulation of nematode male tail tip morphogenesis. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of nuclear pore inner ring. Is expressed in embryonic cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in nephrotic syndrome type 13. Orthologous to human NUP205 (nucleoporin 205). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174834.name: rab-7
174834.summary: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including oocyte growth; phagolysosome assembly involved in apoptotic cell clearance; and positive regulation of early endosome to late endosome transport. Located in late endosome membrane; lysosome; and phagocytic vesicle membrane. Is active in lysosomal membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including oocyte. Used to study obesity. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2B. Orthologous to human RAB7A (RAB7A, member RAS oncogene family). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174838.name: ash-2
174838.description: B30.2/SPRY domain-containing protein;Set1/Ash2 histone methyltransferase complex subunit ash-2
174838.otherdesignations: B30.2/SPRY domain-containing protein;Set1/Ash2 histone methyltransferase complex subunit ash-2
174838.nomenclaturename: B30.2/SPRY domain-containing protein;Set1/Ash2 histone methyltransferase complex subunit ash-2
174838.summary: Predicted to enable transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and programmed cell death. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in germ line. Orthologous to human ASH2L (ASH2 like, histone lysine methyltransferase complex subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174841.name: mcm-2
174841.summary: Predicted to enable single-stranded DNA binding activity. Predicted to contribute to 3'-5' DNA helicase activity and single-stranded DNA helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in double-strand break repair via break-induced replication and mitotic DNA replication initiation. Located in condensed chromosome and pronucleus. Is expressed in excretory cell; intestine; nervous system; reproductive system; and seam cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease and autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 70. Orthologous to human MCM2 (minichromosome maintenance complex component 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174862.name: rsr-2
174862.summary: Located in chromatin and nuclear speck. Is expressed in germ line and somatic cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 72. Orthologous to human SRRM2 (serine/arginine repetitive matrix 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

174934.name: dct-18
174934.summary: Is expressed in intestine. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174963.name: mecr-1
174963.summary: Predicted to enable enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase (NADPH) activity. Predicted to be involved in fatty acid metabolic process. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; nervous system; pharynx; tail; and vulval muscle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in childhood-onset dystonia with optic atrophy and basal ganglia abnormalities and optic atrophy. Orthologous to human MECR (mitochondrial trans-2-enoyl-CoA reductase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174992.name: F45H10.2
174992.summary: Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Predicted to be located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Predicted to be part of respiratory chain complex III. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 4. Orthologous to human UQCRQ (ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase complex III subunit VII). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

174994.name: drr-1
174994.summary: Predicted to be active in membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175001.name: mrpl-37
175001.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human MRPL37 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L37). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175017.name: Y54G9A.7
175017.summary: Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175018.name: bub-3
175018.summary: Predicted to enable ubiquitin binding activity. Involved in Bub1-Bub3 complex localization to kinetochore; embryo development; and negative regulation of metaphase/anaphase transition of cell cycle. Located in nucleoplasm. Orthologous to human BUB3 (BUB3 mitotic checkpoint protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175054.name: daf-5
175054.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity; and SMAD binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of dauer larval development; and transforming growth factor beta receptor signaling pathway. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including ganglia; head neurons; hermaphrodite distal tip cell; intestine; and muscle cell. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175058.name: lem-2
175058.summary: Enables chromatin DNA binding activity and lamin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including microtubule organizing center organization; nuclear membrane reassembly; and response to X-ray. Located in chromosome and nuclear envelope. Used to study Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy and cataract 46 juvenile-onset. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Buschke-Ollendorff syndrome and cataract 46 juvenile-onset. Orthologous to human LEMD3 (LEM domain containing 3) and LEMD2 (LEM domain nuclear envelope protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175072.name: eat-2
175072.summary: Enables acetylcholine-gated monoatomic cation-selective channel activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; larval feeding behavior; and regulation of eating behavior. Located in neuromuscular junction and plasma membrane. Part of acetylcholine-gated channel complex. Is expressed in pm4 and pm5. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease; esophagus squamous cell carcinoma; respiratory system cancer (multiple); and schizophrenia. Orthologous to human CHRFAM7A (CHRNA7 (exons 5-10) and FAM7A (exons A-E) fusion) and CHRNA7 (cholinergic receptor nicotinic alpha 7 subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175080.name: jmjd-2
175080.summary: Enables histone H3K36me/H3K36me2 demethylase activity and histone H3K9me2/H3K9me3 demethylase activity. Predicted to be involved in chromatin remodeling and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be active in chromatin and nucleus. Is expressed in pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including autistic disorder; autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 65; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); head and neck cancer; and withdrawal disorder. Orthologous to several human genes including KDM4C (lysine demethylase 4C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175087.name: ddl-3
175087.summary: Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III assembly. Predicted to be located in mitochondrion. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial inner membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 2. Orthologous to human TTC19 (tetratricopeptide repeat domain 19). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175096.name: mes-2
175096.summary: Enables histone H3K27 methyltransferase activity. Involved in germ-line stem cell division; regulation of gene expression; and tissue development. Part of PcG protein complex and nucleosome. Is expressed in Z2; Z3; germ line; hypodermis; and intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Weaver syndrome; gastrointestinal system cancer (multiple); glioblastoma; hematologic cancer (multiple); and renal Wilms' tumor. Orthologous to human EZH1 (enhancer of zeste 1 polycomb repressive complex 2 subunit) and EZH2 (enhancer of zeste 2 polycomb repressive complex 2 subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175126.name: unc-52
175126.description: Basement membrane proteoglycan;Basement membrane-specific heparan sulfate proteoglycan core protein;Ig-like domain-containing protein
175126.otherdesignations: Basement membrane proteoglycan;Basement membrane-specific heparan sulfate proteoglycan core protein;Ig-like domain-containing protein
175126.nomenclaturename: Basement membrane proteoglycan;Basement membrane-specific heparan sulfate proteoglycan core protein;Ig-like domain-containing protein
175126.summary: An extracellular matrix structural constituent. Involved in several processes, including hemidesmosome assembly; muscle cell cellular homeostasis; and nematode pharyngeal gland morphogenesis. Located in basement membrane and striated muscle dense body. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine; non-striated muscle; pharyngeal-intestinal valve; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Schwartz-Jampel syndrome 1; Silverman-Handmaker type dyssegmental dysplasia; and osteochondrodysplasia. Orthologous to human HSPG2 (heparan sulfate proteoglycan 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175138.name: eif-3.B
175138.description: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit B
175138.otherdesignations: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit B
175138.nomenclaturename: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit B
175138.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity and translation initiation factor binding activity. Predicted to contribute to translation initiation factor activity. Predicted to be involved in regulation of translational initiation and translational initiation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 complex. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; nervous system; pharynx; rectal epithelium; and reproductive system. Orthologous to human EIF3B (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175153.name: nsun-5
175153.summary: Enables rRNA (cytosine-C5-)-methyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of cellular response to heat; negative regulation of locomotion involved in locomotory behavior; and positive regulation of rRNA processing. Predicted to be active in nucleolus. Used to study Williams-Beuren syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including NSUN5 (NOP2/Sun RNA methyltransferase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175172.name: spt-4
175172.summary: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II complex binding activity. Predicted to be involved in transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of DSIF complex. Orthologous to human SUPT4H1 (SPT4 homolog, DSIF elongation factor subunit). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175175.name: pat-4
175175.summary: Enables integrin binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in several processes, including integrin-mediated signaling pathway; muscle cell cellular homeostasis; and positive regulation of supramolecular fiber organization. Located in adherens junction; basal plasma membrane; and contractile muscle fiber. Part of integrin complex. Is expressed in several structures, including enteric muscle; nervous system; pharyngeal-intestinal valve; pharynx; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pancreatic cancer. Orthologous to human ILK (integrin linked kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175180.name: pals-22
175180.summary: Is expressed in several structures, including hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and pharynx. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175184.name: mxl-2
175184.summary: Predicted to enable DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Acts upstream of or within negative regulation of gene expression. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in hypodermis and intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Takayasu's arteritis. Orthologous to human MLX (MAX dimerization protein MLX). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175195.name: gei-4
175195.summary: Involved in negative regulation of Ras protein signal transduction and negative regulation of vulval development. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175218.name: sbds-1
175218.summary: Predicted to be involved in cytosolic ribosome assembly. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm; nuclear lumen; and spindle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Shwachman-Diamond syndrome and aplastic anemia. Orthologous to human SBDS (SBDS ribosome maturation factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175237.name: daf-7
175237.description: Dauer larva development regulatory growth factor daf-7
175237.otherdesignations: Dauer larva development regulatory growth factor daf-7
175237.nomenclaturename: Dauer larva development regulatory growth factor daf-7
175237.summary: Predicted to enable cytokine activity and transforming growth factor beta receptor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to cGMP; regulation of gene expression; and response to bacterium. Located in extracellular region. Is expressed in coelomocyte; neurons; pharynx; and in male. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in myostatin-related muscle hypertrophy and vertebral hypersegmentation and orofacial anomalies. Orthologous to several human genes including GDF11 (growth differentiation factor 11). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175247.name: arx-4
175247.summary: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity and molecular adaptor activity. Involved in epithelial cell migration and morphogenesis of embryonic epithelium. Predicted to be located in actin cytoskeleton. Predicted to be part of Arp2/3 protein complex. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in head; intestine; pharynx; and tail. Orthologous to human ARPC2 (actin related protein 2/3 complex subunit 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175248.name: ucr-2.3
175248.summary: Predicted to enable metalloendopeptidase activity. Involved in protein folding. Predicted to be located in membrane and mitochondrion. Predicted to be active in mitochondrial matrix. Is expressed in neurons and pharyngeal gland cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 5. Orthologous to human UQCRC2 (ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase core protein 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175322.name: ser-4
175322.description: G-protein coupled receptors family 1 profile domain-containing protein
175322.otherdesignations: G-protein coupled receptors family 1 profile domain-containing protein
175322.nomenclaturename: G-protein coupled receptors family 1 profile domain-containing protein
175322.summary: Enables G protein-coupled serotonin receptor activity. Involved in regulation of locomotion and serotonin receptor signaling pathway. Predicted to be located in membrane and synapse. Predicted to be active in dendrite and plasma membrane. Is expressed in neurons; ventral nerve cord; vm2; and vulval cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including alcohol dependence; antisocial personality disorder; anxiety disorder (multiple); depressive disorder (multiple); and substance abuse (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including HTR1A (5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 1A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175338.name: rps-15A
175338.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be located in ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestine; nervous system; and pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 20. Orthologous to human RPS15A (ribosomal protein S15a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175398.name: tufm-1
175398.summary: Predicted to enable translation elongation factor activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translational elongation. Predicted to be active in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 4. Orthologous to human TUFM (Tu translation elongation factor, mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175404.name: klf-1
175404.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including apoptotic cell clearance; regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and xenobiotic metabolic process. Acts upstream of or within determination of adult lifespan. Located in chromatin. Is expressed in hypodermis; intestine; and neurons. Orthologous to human KLF5 (KLF transcription factor 5) and KLF8 (KLF transcription factor 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175410.name: daf-2
175410.description: Insulin-like receptor subunit beta;Protein kinase domain-containing protein;receptor protein-tyrosine kinase
175410.otherdesignations: Insulin-like receptor subunit beta;Protein kinase domain-containing protein;receptor protein-tyrosine kinase
175410.nomenclaturename: Insulin-like receptor subunit beta;Protein kinase domain-containing protein;receptor protein-tyrosine kinase
175410.summary: Enables PTB domain binding activity; SH2 domain binding activity; and protein kinase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including dauer exit; determination of adult lifespan; and regulation of gene expression. Acts upstream of with a negative effect on protein import into nucleus. Located in several cellular components, including axon; neuronal cell body; and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; gonad; nervous system; oocyte; and vulva. Used to study Parkinson's disease and diabetes mellitus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including dementia (multiple); glucose metabolism disease (multiple); kidney cancer (multiple); liver disease (multiple); and reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including IGF1R (insulin like growth factor 1 receptor) and INSRR (insulin receptor related receptor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175433.name: ral-1
175433.summary: Predicted to enable GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; multivesicular body assembly; and positive regulation of vulval development. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be active in plasma membrane. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory cell; germ line; nervous system; vulva; and vulval precursor cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including RALA (RAS like proto-oncogene A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175474.name: wdr-5.1
175474.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; programmed cell death; and transdifferentiation. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of MLL3/4 complex. Is expressed in several structures, including P3.p hermaphrodite; hermaphrodite gonad; hypodermis; neurons; and somatic gonad precursor. Orthologous to human WDR5 (WD repeat domain 5) and WDR5B (WD repeat domain 5B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175490.name: mtm-3
175490.summary: Enables inositol bisphosphate phosphatase activity and phosphatidylinositol phosphate phosphatase activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of autophagosome maturation; and regulation of endocytosis. Located in cytoplasm. Is expressed in body wall musculature and head neurons. Orthologous to several human genes including MTMR3 (myotubularin related protein 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175492.name: dpy-27
175492.summary: Enables sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in dosage compensation by hypoactivation of X chromosome. Located in X chromosome and nuclear chromosome. Part of dosage compensation complex. Orthologous to human SMC4 (structural maintenance of chromosomes 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175501.name: rpl-3
175501.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dilated cardiomyopathy 2D. Orthologous to several human genes including RPL3 (ribosomal protein L3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175504.name: pat-3
175504.summary: Predicted to enable integrin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including muscle cell cellular homeostasis; positive regulation of cellular component organization; and positive regulation of ovulation. Located in several cellular components, including contractile muscle fiber; focal adhesion; and lateral plasma membrane. Part of integrin complex. Is expressed in several structures, including GABAergic neurons; egg-laying apparatus; enteric muscle; gonad; and vulval precursor cell. Used to study cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including amelogenesis imperfecta type 1H; autoimmune thrombocytopenic purpura; blood platelet disease (multiple); coronary artery disease (multiple); and leukocyte adhesion deficiency (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including ITGB1 (integrin subunit beta 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175519.name: tbb-2
175519.summary: Predicted to enable GTP binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Involved in meiotic spindle organization. Located in spindle microtubule. Is expressed in several structures, including excretory cell; neurons; oocyte; pharyngeal gland cell; and reproductive system. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations 1 and congenital fibrosis of the extraocular muscles 3A. Orthologous to human TUBB3 (tubulin beta 3 class III) and TUBB6 (tubulin beta 6 class V). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175522.name: rcq-5
175522.summary: Predicted to enable 3'-5' DNA helicase activity and four-way junction helicase activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA replication and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; intestinal cell; and oocyte. Orthologous to human RECQL5 (RecQ like helicase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175525.name: rnr-2
175525.summary: Predicted to enable ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase activity, thioredoxin disulfide as acceptor. Involved in embryo development. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is expressed in gonad and intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant progressive external ophthalmoplegia with mitochondrial DNA deletions 5; mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 8a; and pancreatic cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including RRM2 (ribonucleotide reductase regulatory subunit M2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175532.name: rnf-5
175532.description: E3 ubiquitin ligase rnf-5;RING finger protein 5;RING-type E3 ubiquitin transferase
175532.otherdesignations: E3 ubiquitin ligase rnf-5;RING finger protein 5;RING-type E3 ubiquitin transferase
175532.nomenclaturename: E3 ubiquitin ligase rnf-5;RING finger protein 5;RING-type E3 ubiquitin transferase
175532.summary: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in several processes, including inductive cell migration; striated muscle cell development; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in cell junction; nucleus; and striated muscle dense body. Is expressed in head neurons; hypodermis; and tail neurons. Orthologous to several human genes including RNF185 (ring finger protein 185). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175541.name: xbp-1
175541.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including IRE1-mediated unfolded protein response; defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; and determination of adult lifespan. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including intestine. Orthologous to human XBP1 (X-box binding protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175545.name: mpk-1
175545.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including intracellular signaling cassette; oocyte maturation; and positive regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; nervous system; oocyte; pharyngeal-intestinal valve; and rectal epithelium. Used to study cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Noonan syndrome 13; Parkinson's disease; carcinoma (multiple); melanoma; and pulmonary hypertension. Orthologous to several human genes including MAPK1 (mitogen-activated protein kinase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175559.name: cdk-12
175559.summary: Predicted to enable RNA polymerase II CTD heptapeptide repeat kinase activity. Involved in nematode larval development. Is active in euchromatin. Is expressed in several structures, including arcade cell; germ line; head; intestine; and rectal gland cell. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital heart defects, dysmorphic facial features, and intellectual developmental disorder; hepatocellular carcinoma; intellectual disability; and prostate carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including CDK13 (cyclin dependent kinase 13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175573.name: prdx-3
175573.summary: Predicted to enable thioredoxin peroxidase activity. Predicted to be involved in cell redox homeostasis; hydrogen peroxide catabolic process; and response to oxidative stress. Predicted to be active in cytosol and mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive spinocerebellar ataxia 32. Orthologous to human PRDX3 (peroxiredoxin 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175582.name: ndg-4
175582.description: Nose resistant-to-fluoxetine protein N-terminal domain-containing protein
175582.otherdesignations: Nose resistant-to-fluoxetine protein N-terminal domain-containing protein
175582.nomenclaturename: Nose resistant-to-fluoxetine protein N-terminal domain-containing protein
175582.summary: Is expressed in hyp3; hyp5; hypodermal cell; and intestine. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175599.name: sel-5
175599.summary: Predicted to enable AP-2 adaptor complex binding activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Predicted to be involved in positive regulation of Notch signaling pathway and regulation of clathrin-dependent endocytosis. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Is expressed in reproductive system and vulval muscle. Used to study Parkinson's disease. Orthologous to human AAK1 (AP2 associated kinase 1) and BMP2K (BMP2 inducible kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175605.name: asb-1
175605.description: ATP synthase F(0) complex subunit B1, mitochondrial
175605.otherdesignations: ATP synthase F(0) complex subunit B1, mitochondrial
175605.nomenclaturename: ATP synthase F(0) complex subunit B1, mitochondrial
175605.summary: Predicted to enable proton transmembrane transporter activity. Predicted to contribute to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Predicted to be involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Located in mitochondrion and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in germ line. Orthologous to human ATP5PB (ATP synthase peripheral stalk-membrane subunit b). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175628.name: rpsa-1
175628.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation and ribosomal small subunit assembly. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm and ribosome. Predicted to be part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; enteric muscle; intestine; pharynx; and tail. Orthologous to several human genes including RPSA (ribosomal protein SA). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175634.name: mel-28
175634.summary: Enables molecular adaptor activity. Involved in mitotic sister chromatid segregation and nuclear pore complex assembly. Located in kinetochore; nuclear envelope; and nucleoplasm. Part of nuclear pore. Orthologous to human AHCTF1 (AT-hook containing transcription factor 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175659.name: rars-1
175659.summary: Predicted to enable arginine-tRNA ligase activity. Involved in translation. Predicted to be located in cytosol. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 9. Orthologous to human RARS1 (arginyl-tRNA synthetase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175660.name: rpb-8
175660.description: putative DNA-directed RNA polymerases I, II, and III subunit RPABC3
175660.otherdesignations: putative DNA-directed RNA polymerases I, II, and III subunit RPABC3
175660.nomenclaturename: putative DNA-directed RNA polymerases I, II, and III subunit RPABC3
175660.summary: Predicted to contribute to DNA-directed RNA polymerase activity. Predicted to be involved in DNA-templated transcription. Predicted to be located in nucleus. Predicted to be part of RNA polymerase I complex; RNA polymerase II, core complex; and RNA polymerase III complex. Orthologous to human POLR2H (RNA polymerase II, I and III subunit H). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175662.name: set-2
175662.summary: Enables histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and transdifferentiation. Located in nucleus. Is expressed in several structures, including germ line; hermaphrodite distal tip cell; hypodermis; nerve ring; and neurons. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in early-onset epilepsy 2 and neurodevelopmental disorder with speech impairment and dysmorphic facies. Orthologous to human SETD1A (SET domain containing 1A, histone lysine methyltransferase) and SETD1B (SET domain containing 1B, histone lysine methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175672.name: vps-22
175672.summary: Predicted to be involved in protein transport to vacuole involved in ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the multivesicular body sorting pathway. Predicted to be part of ESCRT II complex. Is expressed in body wall musculature; intestine; neurons; pharynx; and vulval muscle. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy. Orthologous to human SNF8 (SNF8 subunit of ESCRT-II). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175681.name: wip-1
175681.summary: Predicted to enable actin binding activity. Involved in embryonic body morphogenesis; regulation of cell migration; and regulation of protein stability. Is expressed in hypodermis. Orthologous to human WIPF1 (WAS/WASL interacting protein family member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175693.name: cox-6A
175693.summary: Predicted to enable enzyme regulator activity. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial electron transport, cytochrome c to oxygen. Located in mitochondrion. Is expressed in body wall musculature; hypodermis; intestine; and pharynx. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease recessive intermediate D and mitochondrial complex IV deficiency nuclear type 18. Orthologous to human COX6A1 (cytochrome c oxidase subunit 6A1) and COX6A2 (cytochrome c oxidase subunit 6A2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175704.name: ulp-1
175704.summary: Predicted to enable deSUMOylase activity. Involved in several processes, including embryo development; positive regulation of error-prone translesion synthesis; and protein desumoylation. Predicted to be located in nuclear envelope. Predicted to be active in nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including SENP2 (SUMO specific peptidase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175707.name: cid-1
175707.summary: Enables RNA uridylyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in polyuridylation-dependent mRNA catabolic process. Located in P granule; condensed nuclear chromosome; and perinuclear region of cytoplasm. Is expressed in germ line and intestine. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in liver benign neoplasm. Orthologous to human TUT4 (terminal uridylyl transferase 4) and TUT7 (terminal uridylyl transferase 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

175708.name: pup-2
175708.summary: Enables RNA uridylyltransferase activity. Involved in pre-miRNA processing. Is expressed in germ line. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in liver benign neoplasm. Orthologous to human TUT4 (terminal uridylyl transferase 4) and TUT7 (terminal uridylyl transferase 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175716.name: atp-2
175716.summary: Enables protein domain specific binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; inductive cell migration; and nematode pharyngeal pumping. Located in mitochondrion and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in several structures, including enteric muscle; excretory cell; intestine; nervous system; and reproductive system. Orthologous to human ATP5F1B (ATP synthase F1 subunit beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175725.name: gro-1
175725.summary: Predicted to enable tRNA dimethylallyltransferase activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan and regulation of growth. Located in mitochondrion and nucleus. Is expressed widely. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 35. Orthologous to human TRIT1 (tRNA isopentenyltransferase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175727.name: daf-41
175727.summary: Predicted to enable Hsp90 protein binding activity and protein-folding chaperone binding activity. Predicted to be involved in chaperone-mediated protein complex assembly and protein folding. Located in myofibril. Is expressed in several structures, including anal depressor muscle; intestine; nervous system; reproductive system; and seam cell. Orthologous to several human genes including PTGES3 (prostaglandin E synthase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

175729.name: clk-1
175729.summary: Enables transcription cis-regulatory region binding activity. Involved in several processes, including determination of adult lifespan; positive regulation of growth rate; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in mitochondrion and nucleus. Is expressed widely. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive distal hereditary motor neuronopathy 9 and primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency 8. Orthologous to human COQ7 (coenzyme Q7, hydroxylase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
